title: PolitiFact (Poynter Institute): Joe Biden's sanctions on Russia “are riddled with loopholes and don't even start for 30 days.
text:
Joe Biden's sanctions on Russia “are riddled with loopholes and don't even start for 30 days. They have carve outs for the energy and financial sectors.”
Some of the U.S. sanctions against Russia took immediate effect, while some were phased in over 30 days. The energy sector was largely spared, but banks were targeted directly.

title: PolitiFact (Poynter Institute): Video shows North Korean President Kim Jong Un blaming President Joe Biden for the Israel-Hamas war and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and
text:
Video shows North Korean President Kim Jong Un blaming President Joe Biden for the Israel-Hamas war and Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, and saying, “I support Donald Trump for President in 2024.”
This speech was from Oct. 10, 2020. A translation and news reports about the speech’s content show that the English captions superimposed on the video are inaccurate.

text:
George Soros is banned in Russia, Pakistan, Turkey, Hungary, Poland and the Philippines.

title: PolitiFact (Poynter Institute): In an interview with Tucker Carlson, Russian President Vladimir Putin said he finds the U.S.-Mexico border issue “ironically amusing.”
text:
In an interview with Tucker Carlson, Russian President Vladimir Putin said he finds the U.S.-Mexico border issue “ironically amusing.”
This exchange between former Fox News host Tucker Carlson and Russian President Vladimir Putin was fabricated. Carlson and Putin did not discuss the U.S.-Mexico border in the two-hour interview.

title: PolitiFact (Poynter Institute): "While Americans are paying record high prices at the pump, this administration decides to give our oil to the EU and China."
text:
"While Americans are paying record high prices at the pump, this administration decides to give our oil to the EU and China."
Reserve oil is sold to the highest bidder, by law. The oil market operates on a global level; lower prices are the results of changes to supply and demand on a global basis, not just in the U.S.

title: PolitiFact (Poynter Institute): “The weapons that Ukraine used in the early days of this war to fend off the Russian invasion are the weapons that Donald Trump sent, that
text:
“The weapons that Ukraine used in the early days of this war to fend off the Russian invasion are the weapons that Donald Trump sent, that Barack Obama and Joe Biden had refused to send.”
The Obama administration in 2014 rejected Ukraine’s request for Javelins. The Trump and Biden administration provided that aid.
